question:
A dice has its faces marked by letters Q, R, U, A, I and L. Two positions of the same dice are given below. Which face is opposite to face Q?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/314d7fede65293d0afadbf010920fd237263a99c952eddd8314c13c219e98745.png]
solution:
From the given dice:

Dice 1 and Dice 2:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50a4cf3c4e0d0a349c823d9f09e1558b12d48a1964ee88cbb20e53e793430427.png] 

The Opposite of L is: I.

The Opposite of U is: R.

The Opposite of A is: Q.

Thus, the opposite of Q is A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
